payload.instructions:
You analyse customer feedback for a product team, using the Value Proposition Canvas.

For each text, find:
- jobs: what the customer is trying to get done, in their words (a goal, not a feature).
- pains: what frustrates, blocks or risks that job.
- gains: what the customer wants or would be delighted by.
Each with a short label from the customer's point of view (2 to 7 words, in the language of the text), an intensity from 1 (mild) to 3 (strong), and a quote: the exact words from the text that show it, copied character for character.

Also give each text's overall sentiment (positive, negative, mixed or neutral) and its main type (bug, feature request, question, praise, complaint or other).

Rules:
- Only what the text says. A text can have no jobs, pains or gains.
- Placeholders such as [NAME_1] or [EMAIL_2] replace removed personal data. Never guess what they stand for, and never put them in a label.
- Answer only with JSON: {"texts": [{"id": "...", "jobs": [...], "pains": [...], "gains": [...], "sentiment": "...", "type": "..."}]}, one entry per text, with each job, pain and gain as {"label": "...", "intensity": 1, "quote": "..."}.
payload.mergeInstructions:
You group what customers said into themes for a product team, using the Value Proposition Canvas.

You get one kind at a time: jobs (what customers are trying to get done), pains (what frustrates, blocks or risks a job) or gains (what customers want or would be delighted by). Each label has an id and the number of texts it came from. Labels are in German or English.

Put labels that mean the same thing for the customer into one theme, whatever their language. Keep different things apart: a theme should be specific enough for a team to act on. Give each theme a short name from the customer's point of view, 2 to 7 words, in English.

Rules:
- Every label id in exactly one theme. A label that fits no other is a theme of its own.
- Placeholders such as [NAME_1] or [EMAIL_2] replace removed personal data. Never put them in a theme name.
- Answer only with JSON: {"themes": [{"name": "...", "labels": ["l1", "l7"]}]}.

texts.text: Can I give my accountant read-only access without sharing my password?
Where do I find the VAT return? I've clicked through every menu twice.
Love the new dashboard!
I waited six days for a reply from support. By then I had sorted it out myself.
We track every project's hours and costs here, but I can't see profit per project anywhere. That's the whole reason we signed up.
Recurring invoices would save me an hour every month. I send the same five invoices on the first of the month.
Honestly, the price increase in October was not great. You doubled the price and added nothing I use.
Is there an API? We want to push orders from our web shop straight into invoices.
Bank sync works fine for my main account but my credit card account never updates.
The new navigation is confusing. Things moved and nothing is where it used to be.
Payroll is easy, but the payslip PDF shows the wrong tax year in the header.
Thanks [NAME_1], you solved my problem in five minutes. Best support I've had from a software company.
The mobile app is fine for checking invoices, but uploading receipts fails without a signal. Offline mode would help a lot on building sites.
I need to file VAT every quarter and the app makes it painless. Just wish it reminded me a week before the deadline.
Everything is slow since the update. Opening an invoice takes 10 seconds.
The report builder is powerful but I can't figure out how to show months as columns.
Customer for 6 years and still happy.
I tried to cancel the extra user seat and the page just reloads. Still being billed for it.
Expenses: when I forward a receipt by email it lands in the inbox, but the amount is never read correctly.
Can you add a filter for unpaid invoices older than 30 days? I build that list by hand every week.
The bank connection asks me to re-authorise every 90 days. Is that something you can change or is it the bank?
It's good, but too expensive for a one-person business.
The invoice template editor keeps resetting my logo size.
After the last update the app logs me out every few minutes on my tablet.
Brilliant for invoicing, rubbish for anything else. The expense side feels like an afterthought.
What's the difference between the Standard and Plus plans? The pricing page doesn't say whether payroll is included.
The bank feed duplicates some transactions and I have to delete them by hand before reconciling.
We'd pay more for phone support. Email-only support doesn't work when payroll is due tomorrow.
Thanks for adding bulk delete!
I manage the books for my partner's practice and mine. Switching between the two companies takes far too many clicks.
The year-end checklist is great, it walked me through closing the year step by step.
Payslips should be sent to employees by email directly, not downloaded and attached by me one by one.
The app keeps crashing on iOS when I open the camera to scan a receipt.
Please let me schedule invoices to be sent on a specific date.
I keep getting logged out, and every time I have to wait for the text message code.
Is it possible to have different invoice numbering for two business lines?
The VAT report groups everything by rate, but my tax office wants it by category.
My accountant says the export is missing the cost centre field.
Will there be a Shopify integration? We sell online and type every order in by hand.
I still can't figure out how to add a second bank account.
Your onboarding videos are excellent. Got set up in an afternoon.
The PDF export of the balance sheet has overlapping text in the last column.
Support replied within an hour and fixed the problem. Thank you, [NAME_3].
Our invoices get flagged as spam by some clients' email systems.
Bank sync is reliable now, thanks for whatever you changed.
Can I see the history of changes on an invoice? Someone changed an amount and I don't know who.
We want to give our sales team access to create quotes, but not to see salaries.
Every time the app updates on my phone I have to log in again with the code.
Sending invoices from my own email address instead of yours would look more professional.
I just need the numbers for my tax advisor at the end of each quarter, nothing more.
Please add a German interface for our Vienna office.
Why can't I delete a draft invoice?
I use the app to see which projects are actually making money, and the project profit report finally shows me that. Fantastic.
The receipt scanner reads the date wrong when it's written day first.
The cash flow forecast is useless because it ignores recurring expenses.
I can't attach the delivery note to the invoice, my clients need both in one email.
Mileage tracking would be handy. I drive to clients every day and log the kilometres in a paper notebook.
The time tracker forgets my entries if I switch to another tab before saving.
We hired our first employee and the payroll setup wizard asked questions I couldn't answer. A checklist of what to prepare would help.
Fine for now. We'll see how it handles our growth next year.
